scientific_integrity: Standalone finite checks do not replace the coarea and conditional-divergence proofs; the unmodified Gaussian estimator is well-defined almost surely; deterministic blow-up and spherical quadratic form densities are credited as prior art.
scientific_limitations: Exact leading tail coefficient only for k=n-1; unregularized real Gaussian sketches of invertible indefinite inputs in exact arithmetic; no results for stabilized cores or other sampling models; no independent validation.
title: Universal non-integrable error of Gaussian indefinite Nystrom sketches
